title: Kung Pao Shrimp with Dulet Sauce
description: A spicy and savory Chinese-inspired dish packed with shrimp, dulet, and a hint of velvety goodness.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the dulet and cook until slightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the shrimp and dulet, and stir-fry until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Stir in the Berbere spice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.
